source.what: Synthetic montage under a recorded voiceover (phone voiceover montage writer). The scout read the 19 newest variants_ready prod jobs (2026-10-27 to 2026-10-31): none had a recorded voiceover.
source.captured: hand-written 2026-11-01 (no prod thread found by the KRI-1097 fixture scout)
reconstructed: everything: creator message, Creative Brief, planner strategy and summary, clips

the planner's choices are written as the planner returns them for this request (post-parse strategy, with the server's provenance flags where the creator states a pace or a length); no model is replayed
the approval card is assembled offline from the real pure functions the draft turn calls (scripts/kria/score_route.py approval_card); the DB-bound turn body is not run
phone source bindings: synthetic proxy paths (score_route.media_rows)
the recorded voiceover itself (the card does not read it; media_snapshot carries no voiceover in this fixture)

4.title_animation.why: the planned title animation reaches the intro text; today it is drawn with cluster_style None

5.r1.why: about 30 seconds: the render meets the stated length

5.r2.why: animate the text: animation_ask reaches the intro

not_graded.no_text: a skipped opening title (omitted_copy_targets) is not in this fixture: its intro text conflicts with the animation ask; the voiceover lane adds its own fixture if it honors it
